_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "class_name" TEXT NULL, "roll_number" TEXT NULL, "staff_id" TEXT NULL, "qr_code_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "lunch_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "breakfast_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "brunch_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grace_allowance_override" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "member_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "scanned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'accepted', "via_grace" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("via_grace" IN (0, 1)), "reversed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reversed" IN (0, 1)), "reversed_at" INTEGER NULL, "reversed_by" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "member_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "lunch_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "breakfast_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "brunch_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_pdf_path" TEXT NULL, "upi_qr_path" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reversed" IN (0, 1)), "reversed_at" INTEGER NULL, "reversed_by" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refunds" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "member_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id), "lunch_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "breakfast_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "brunch_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "refund_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "processed_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "categories_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "items_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ingredients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "dish_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dish_name_lower" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "ingredients_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_schedule_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ingredient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ingredients (id), "ingredient_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "ingredient_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_note" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchased" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("purchased" IN (0, 1)), "purchased_by" TEXT NULL, "purchased_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("token" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("token"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notifications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "visible_roles_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "dismissed_by_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("type", "date_key", "meal_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grace_allowance_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("grace_allowance_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "grace_allowance_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reversal_window_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "breakfast_start" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '07:00', "breakfast_end" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '09:30', "lunch_start" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '12:00', "lunch_end" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '14:30', "brunch_start" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '09:00', "brunch_end" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '12:00', "local_timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Kolkata', "upi_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "upi_payee_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "lunch_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "breakfast_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "brunch_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "app_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Tiffin', "prep_lead_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "purchase_lead_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "host_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "enforce_appearance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enforce_appearance" IN (0, 1)), "appearance_theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'neobrutal', "appearance_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "appearance_motion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("appearance_motion" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
